_evidence: MEASURED (config.json + every safetensors header; MoE active-parameter arithmetic cross-checked against the body's own nameplate). Zero mlx/torch load, zero HCLI resident contention -- run while the repaired selfdev campaign held the GPU.
_label: Odyssey I DISCOVERY, COHORT PASS. The eight bodies that could plausibly replace sealed-3.14 as HCLI's Resident. ANATOMY ONLY -- the capability half of S007's judgement is gated on G004/G005 and is NOT claimed here.

incumbent.name: sealed-3.14 (current)
incumbent.note: the incumbent, and the body every candidate below has to beat on VERIFIED ACCEPTED WORK / WALL / RESOURCES -- not on size or speed

THE_RESIDENT_QUESTION.s007_metric: VERIFIED ACCEPTED WORK / WALL / MEMORY / RESOURCES -- explicitly not TPS, and explicitly not size.
THE_RESIDENT_QUESTION.what_this_pass_can_and_cannot_say: it supplies the DENOMINATOR (memory, active compute, context reach) and says nothing about the numerator. Every candidate below has completed exactly zero verified HCLI WorkUnits, which is also true of the incumbent: sealed-3.14 has landed ZERO self-authored changes in 66 cycles. The incumbent's advantage is incumbency, not demonstrated work.
THE_RESIDENT_QUESTION.standout_on_anatomy: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B. It is the only body here that is simultaneously (a) MoE with a small active fraction, so per-token compute is a fraction of its size, (b) CODE-specialised, which is HCLI's actual domain -- every WorkUnit is a repo edit, (c) 262144-token context, 32x the incumbent's 8192. Experiment 1 hit that 8192 ceiling hard enough to need an admission guard inside the tool loop, so context is not a theoretical axis here; it is a measured past failure.
THE_RESIDENT_QUESTION.cheapest_credible: Qwen3-4B-Instruct -- 262144 context as well, at a fraction of the footprint. If capability holds it dominates on resources outright; that IS the S003 hypothesis ('a 6B that completes verified work faster may be the superior Resident even if raw intelligence is lower').
THE_RESIDENT_QUESTION.honest_counterweight: small/sparse bodies are exactly where tool-call reliability and malformed-call rate tend to degrade, and experiment 1 showed the incumbent's tool-call DIALECT eroding under long generation (four substrate fixes went into parsing it). Malformed-call rate is an explicit S007 judging axis and is unmeasured for every candidate here. Anatomy cannot settle this.

CONTEXT_IS_THE_SHARPEST_ANATOMICAL_GAP.finding: six of eight candidates exceed the incumbent's context, two of them by 32x. This is the one axis where the anatomy alone already favours replacement, and it is backed by a real incident rather than a preference: cycles in experiment 1 died with 'prompt is 10203 tokens and native max_seq_len is 8192', which is what forced the admission guard that now evicts turns mid-loop.
CONTEXT_IS_THE_SHARPEST_ANATOMICAL_GAP.QUALIFIED_BY_A_LATER_MEASUREMENT: This receipt originally treated context reach as a clean win over the incumbent. It is HALF the picture. Serving that context costs KV, measured in receipts/odyssey-i/O00X_KV_COST_OF_CONTEXT.json: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B needs 24.0 GiB of KV at its advertised 262144 tokens on top of 56.9 GiB of weights, and Qwen3-4B-Instruct needs 36.0 GiB at the same context against only 7.5 GiB of weights -- nearly 5x its own body. Context CAPABILITY and context AFFORDABILITY are different claims and only the first was measured here. At HCLI's real working context (~8k) every candidate is cheap (0.47-4.00 GiB), so the honest reading is: reach is a genuine advantage over the incumbent's 8192 ceiling, and a cost that materialises only when actually used.

obvious_representation_opportunities: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B is the one body here where this session's MoE organ rules (expert-only precision, shared expert bases, expert deltas, protected routers) apply directly -- 128 experts, 8 per token. It is also the only MoE in the tier, so it is the natural next Gravity patient after O005/O006.

The dense bodies (Qwen3-14B, Phi-4-reasoning-plus, Mistral-Small-24B, Olmo-3-7B, starcoder2-7b) have no expert organ, so per R-specialist-body-single-organ's sibling logic their search is cross-layer structure, not organ allocation.
failure_modes_not_yet_tested: EVERYTHING that decides the Resident question: WorkUnit completion, tool reliability, malformed-call rate, recovery, context SERVABILITY (as opposed to advertised context), latency, accepted work/hour, supervisor intervention. All gated on G004/G005 per the standing resource law.
Advertised context is a config assertion. None of these has served a long prompt on this machine.
preliminary_disposition: RESIDENT-CANDIDATE SHORTLIST, QUALIFICATION DEFERRED. Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B ranks first on anatomy for HCLI's actual job; Qwen3-4B-Instruct is the cheapest credible challenger. Neither claim survives contact with a capability battery that has not been run.

preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.pulsar_candidate: Qwen3-4B-Instruct / Phi-4-mini -- smallest fast executors, untested
preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.cepheid_candidate: none of these; an independent calibrator wants a scorer, not a generator
preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.verdict: SHORTLIST ONLY. S007 permits controlled Resident trials only AFTER G004/G005 establish the substrate works, and that gate has not been passed.

DUPLICATE_EXPORT_TRAP_caught_before_publ.what: the directory ships the SAME model twice: consolidated.safetensors (44.72 GiB, Mistral's native naming, e.g. layers.0.attention.wq.weight) AND a 10-shard copy (44.72 GiB, HF naming, e.g. language_model.model.embed_tokens.weight).
DUPLICATE_EXPORT_TRAP_caught_before_publ.proof_they_are_the_same_model: 585 tensors each; ZERO name overlap between the two conventions; identical parameter totals (24,011,361,280 both) and IDENTICAL shape/dtype multisets. Same weights, two export conventions -- not two different artifacts.
DUPLICATE_EXPORT_TRAP_caught_before_publ.the_trap: a naive *.safetensors glob counts both and reports 48.02B for a body whose own name says 24B. This session has published four genuine 'the name disagrees with the measurement' findings (BitNet 1.58-vs-2.0, pi0's gemma_300m-vs-575M, iLLaDA raw-vs-logical, Qwen3-0.6B raw-vs-logical), so a fifth would have looked entirely plausible and been WRONG. What caught it: 48.02 is suspiciously EXACTLY 2x 24, and an exact factor of two is a counting bug until proven otherwise.
DUPLICATE_EXPORT_TRAP_caught_before_publ.storage_finding: 44.72 GiB of this one specimen is redundant. Lake-wide scan for the same pattern (a consolidated file alongside shards) found only two other hits, both small and NOT full duplicates (moshika 0.36G, Inkling-Small 4.16G against 491G of shards). So this is one specimen's packaging choice, not a lake-wide convention -- but it is 44.72 GiB against a lake already recorded as being over budget, and it is reclaimable with no capability cost once a loader convention is chosen.
DUPLICATE_EXPORT_TRAP_caught_before_publ.method_correction_applied: the cohort script now prefers the sharded copy and asserts the deduped Mistral measures ~24B, so the trap cannot silently return.
